baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural causative imperative at 24:32:1 and its objects, the unpartnered and suitable dependents.
baseline_models.mechanism: The causative marriage branch assigns the addressees an enabling role: they are to bring other people into a marriage bond, so lack of a spouse is treated as a communal coordination problem as well as an individual condition.

activation_trace.role: Causing another to marry is the literal branch and makes communal facilitation the operative mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A general endorsement of individuals marrying.
changed_reading.after: A plural charge to those with social agency to cause marriages to become possible for others.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated groups at 24:32:2-7, especially the suitable among male and female slaves.
baseline_models.mechanism: Suitability, not freedom or existing wealth, is the stated positive filter. The command crosses the free-servile boundary and includes owned men and women within the community's marriage-enabling responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Fitness and compatibility are the literal branch and supply the eligibility criterion.
Owned servitude is the literal status named and marks a boundary the command crosses.
The owned woman is the literal branch and makes female slaves explicit beneficiaries rather than an implied remainder.
Causing marriage supplies the common action applied across the listed statuses.

changed_reading.before: Marriage support is primarily for already independent and economically established people.
changed_reading.after: Practical suitability can ground marriage support across status, including for owned dependents.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence at 24:32:9-17: if they are poor, God will suffice them from His surplus, and God is expansive and knowing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Present need is not made a veto. Sufficiency is grammatically placed after the marriage command and is sourced in gift and expansive capacity, while knowledge keeps the promise attentive to actual conditions.

activation_trace.role: Material need and small means are the literal branch and name the apparent barrier.
Making another sufficient is the literal branch and supplies the promised reversal of need.
Gracious gift beyond obligation is the literal source from which sufficiency comes.
Amplitude of wealth and livelihood is the literal branch and removes a zero-sum ceiling from the promise.
Knowledge as disclosed awareness qualifies expansiveness as informed rather than indiscriminate.

changed_reading.before: Economic surplus must exist before marriage can responsibly begin.
changed_reading.after: Need does not itself disqualify: sufficiency may arise after entry into the supported bond.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The close sequence of marry, poor, enrich, and surplus at 24:32.
baseline_models.mechanism: The enrichment inventory itself includes marriage as a form of fortifying the unmarried. That permits a non-pecuniary baseline in which the bond can produce a kind of sufficiency even before any increase in cash.

activation_trace.role: Enrichment through marriage is the literal branch and lets the promise include relational fortification.
The marriage contract is the literal bond that could instantiate this non-pecuniary sufficiency.
Gift beyond obligation keeps the resulting sufficiency broader than earned wages alone.

changed_reading.before: God will enrich them means only that their monetary holdings will increase.
changed_reading.after: The marriage bond itself may be one component of the sufficiency and fortification promised.

context_deltas.mechanism: Whole-surah repetitions turn divine provision into a circulation system. People who possess surplus and means are told to give; emancipating dependents are given from wealth called God's; provision is apportioned; and kin households share edible portions. God's sufficing can therefore arrive through commanded human transfers without ceasing to be God's gift.

activation_trace.role: Concrete need is the focus deficit that the circulation must answer.
Making others sufficient is the focus outcome re-read as potentially mediated.
Surplus and remainder are literal resources held by people and made available for distribution.
Human amplitude of wealth and livelihood identifies agents able to carry provision.
Giving is the literal action that converts possessed amplitude into another's support.
The repeated giving root marks both God's prior grant and the required onward transfer to dependents.
Possessed wealth is the material routed from divine source to a person seeking release.
Apportioned gift names divine provision while leaving its delivery channel open.
An edible share is the literal branch and extends provision into the kin-household network.

structural_cues: 24:22 couples possessors of surplus and means with an imperative to give to vulnerable relations and migrants.
24:33 calls the transferred funds God's wealth that God first gave the current holders.
24:61 permits eating across a wide kin-house network, together or separately.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated surplus, capacity, giving, divine wealth, apportioned provision, and shared food; I infer the arrow from divine source through human redistribution to the poor couple. A direct or otherwise unseen act of provision remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The poverty clause predicts a private windfall delivered independently of the community.
changed_reading.after: Divine sufficiency can be realized through the community's commanded circulation of surplus, grants, and household provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah acknowledges people who cannot obtain marriage and gives them a chastity-until-sufficiency path; the later ayah recognizes women who no longer expect marriage and again values chastity. The focus imperative therefore mobilizes facilitators without making immediate marriage compulsory for every unpartnered person.

activation_trace.role: Causing others to marry places the focus obligation on enabling addressees.
Finding or obtaining is the literal branch, and its negation acknowledges real unavailability.
The marriage bond is the unavailable object rather than an act demanded regardless of conditions.
Refraining from what is improper supplies an affirmative conduct for the waiting interval.
Arrival at independence or freedom from need marks the temporal endpoint of waiting.
Women who have ceased expecting menstruation or marriage are a literal recognized category outside an immediate-marriage trajectory.
Hope as orientation to an expected outcome makes non-expectation of marriage explicit.
The same marriage bond is here something not anticipated, limiting a universalizing reading of the focus.
Chosen restraint is again valued and preserves a non-marriage path within the surah.

structural_cues: 24:32 addresses those who can arrange marriage; 24:33 immediately addresses those who cannot obtain it.
The word until in 24:33 makes waiting conditional and temporal rather than a failure.
24:60 explicitly recognizes a class not expecting marriage and describes restraint as better for them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct addressees, inability, an interval of restraint, and later non-expectation; I infer that the plural command is facilitative rather than coercive. A narrower reading that treats 24:60 as an unrelated age-specific exception remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Every unpartnered person is under pressure to marry immediately, with poverty dismissed as irrelevant.
changed_reading.after: The community must open viable paths to marriage, while candidates retain a recognized waiting or non-marriage path when the bond is unavailable or not expected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The run from house-entry permission through guarded sexual boundaries, named husbands, marriage, and fortification frames the bond as an authorized household threshold. Marriage does not simply permit sex; it creates a protected relation whose access remains structured by enclosure, permission, and restraint.

activation_trace.role: The marriage contract is the focus anchor that can create an authorized relational boundary.
The marriage-house branch lets the surrounding houses function as a model of bounded domestic relation.
Permission and authorization are the literal threshold rule for entering protected space.
Guarding sexual inviolability is the literal branch and defines what the institution must preserve.
The private opening is the literal object guarded before the marriage command.
Husbands are the explicitly named spouse relation within the controlled disclosure network.
Fortification by contract or inviolability gives the bond its protective rather than merely permissive function.

structural_cues: 24:27-29 regulate entry into houses by recognition and permission.
24:30-31 symmetrically command guarding of private parts before naming husbands among bounded relations.
24:33 opposes coerced sexual commerce to a woman's desire for fortification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies domestic thresholds, permission, guarded sexuality, spouses, and fortification; I infer that marriage joins these into protected household access. The norms could instead be read as neighboring but institutionally independent commands.

changed_reading.before: Marriage is chiefly a status change or a license for sexual access.
changed_reading.after: Marriage is an authorized household enclosure that makes intimacy legitimate by preserving boundaries rather than erasing them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The slave-inclusive focus is immediately followed by funded manumission contracts and a ban on forcing owned young women into sexual commerce when they seek fortification. Later, servitude is directed exclusively toward God within a promised change from fear to security. Marriage support thus sits inside a wider program that limits owners' extraction and opens owned people toward covenant, resources, and agency.

activation_trace.role: Owned servitude is the literal focus status whose treatment is being changed.
The owned woman is explicitly included in the marriage-enabling command.
A slave's written contract for release is the literal branch and supplies a status-exit mechanism.
Required giving funds the dependent rather than merely releasing the owner's claim.
Forcing another into what she rejects is the literal mechanism explicitly prohibited.
The euphemism for an owned young woman identifies the person protected from the owner's extraction.
Sexual commerce is the exploitative branch contrasted with her sought fortification.
Guarded sexual integrity is the woman's stated aim and makes her agency visible.
Submissive worship is redirected to God and supplies the later horizon beyond human ownership.
Changing one condition into another supports a surah-level movement from fear and subjection toward security.

structural_cues: 24:33 immediately follows the marriage command with contract, assessment, funding, anti-coercion, and fortification clauses.
The same verse distinguishes what the dependents seek from what owners may seek to extract.
24:55 pairs social establishment and changed security with worship of God alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent legal-economic protections and a later exclusive-worship horizon; I infer a common arrow from owned object toward protected agent. The marriage, manumission, and anti-prostitution rules may also be independent remedies rather than one staged program.

changed_reading.before: Male and female slaves are passive beneficiaries whom owners simply place into marriages.
changed_reading.after: Their inclusion is part of an anti-exploitative framework that recognizes desire, funds possible release, blocks sexual coercion, and makes marriage one protected covenantal option.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, the suitability root appears as repair after wrongdoing and as performed good works, while human sponsors are asked to discern beneficial capacity in dependents before contracting release. This shifts the focus adjective from a fixed prestige label toward repairable, enacted, and assessable fitness.

activation_trace.role: Fitness and compatibility are the focus branch whose temporality is being revised.
Repair as the opposite of corruption makes soundness something people can actively restore.
Knowing as disclosed recognition makes human assessment part of enabling a dependent's transition.
Beneficial good is the capacity to be discerned rather than a hereditary status.
Soundness appears as performed works, reinforcing an enacted rather than merely ascribed quality.
Enablement and established capacity show good action issuing into viable social standing.
Security and trust are the condition into which the community is moved, not a status presumed in advance.

structural_cues: 24:5 places repair after a prior offense.
24:33 requires sponsors to know good in dependents before supporting a contract.
24:55 links good works with establishment and a change from fear to security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repair, performed good, discerned benefit, and enablement; I infer that suitability can develop and be socially recognized. The focus adjective may still mean a simpler fixed predicate such as morally righteous.

changed_reading.before: The suitable are a prequalified moral class already complete before support begins.
changed_reading.after: Suitability can include practical fit and demonstrated capacity that is repaired, enacted, discerned, and enabled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats marriage, God's enriching, and surplus, then opposes sexual coercion to sought fortification. Together with the enrichment branch that explicitly overlaps marriage, this strengthens a coexisting reading in which the bond itself supplies protected relational sufficiency, not only later income.

activation_trace.role: Marriage as enrichment is the focus branch whose contextual recurrence is being tested.
The marriage contract supplies the relation capable of functioning as fortification.
Immediate repetition keeps the formal marriage bond beside the repeated enrichment promise.
The same marriage-enrichment branch permits sufficiency here to remain partly relational.
Restraint names the vulnerable interval that a protected bond can help resolve.
Fortification by contract or inviolability supplies the protective effect of relational sufficiency.
Gracious gift keeps both material and relational forms of sufficiency under the same source.

structural_cues: 24:33 immediately repeats the focus sequence marriage, enrichment, God, and surplus.
The latter half of 24:33 makes sought fortification the opposite of coerced sexual exploitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical overlap between enrichment and marriage plus the adjacent fortification contrast; I infer that the bond can be part of what enriches. A strictly pecuniary sense of the verb remains materially live.

changed_reading.before: The promise concerns only money acquired after marriage.
changed_reading.after: The protected relation itself may be one gift of sufficiency, alongside any later material increase.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a cloud mechanism into social provision. It remains packet-anchored through poverty's hollow branch, causative marriage, and 24:43's joining, accumulation, gap, and rain sequence; downstream prose should label it an exploratory material analogy, not a lexical gloss or guaranteed causal law.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The poverty term at 24:32:10 and the causative marriage command at 24:32:1.

activation_trace.role: A hollow or outlet in the ground lets need be imaged as a gap rather than only a quantity of missing cash.
Causing a bond supplies the social act of bringing separated units into relation.
Joining one thing to another supplies the first material operation in the analogy.
Accumulation into a mass shows joined units gaining productive capacity.
A need that fills a gap links the rain passage back to the focus image of lack.
Descending rain is the material yield that emerges after joining and accumulation.

changed_reading.before: Poverty is a sealed absence that must be filled before any bond is formed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, visible need can be the gap around which coordinated joining accumulates a provision-bearing structure, as joined clouds yield rain through their interstices.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of the focus root as an anti-reading, not as the surface word's direct sense. It remains valid as a contained warning anchored in the plural imperative and 24:22's giving by people of means; downstream prose should say that wideness must not be confused with social abandonment, not that the adjective literally means neglect.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The closing divine attribute at 24:32:16 read beside the opening plural imperative.

activation_trace.role: Spatial or practical expansiveness is the dominant literal branch of the divine attribute.
The split-root image of letting livestock wander into loss supplies the deliberately contained anti-reading.
The plural duty to cause marriages prevents divine amplitude from erasing human responsibility.
Human means and ample livelihood identify capacity that must remain socially active.
The command to give turns amplitude into care rather than laissez-faire release.

changed_reading.before: Because God is vast, the community may leave poor unpartnered people entirely to divine provision.
changed_reading.after: As a split-root anti-reading, divine wideness cannot be invoked to let vulnerable people drift; the community's own amplitude must move toward active facilitation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's split mapping from the owned-woman token toward mother and household center; it does not claim that the token literally means mother. It remains anchored by the paired mapped inventories, 24:33's anti-coercion, and 24:61's mothers within the house network; downstream prose should present it as a counter-status resonance that restores latent kin-generating personhood.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The explicitly named female slaves at 24:32:7 within a command to establish marriage.

activation_trace.role: The owned woman is the literal status from which the counter-status activation begins.
The split mapped image of mother as bearer and nurturer exposes a possible kin-generating future not exhausted by ownership.
The euphemism for an owned young woman keeps the same vulnerable person in view after the marriage command.
The ban on forcing her protects the agency needed for any genuine transition into kinship.
Mothers as literal nurturers appear inside the later kin-household resource network.
Household members and dependents form the network into which the counter-status reading imagines incorporation.

changed_reading.before: The female slave is a property subclass whom an owner may assign a spouse.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the command recognizes an owned woman as a possible origin and nurturer of kin whose personhood cannot be contained by her current property status.

strongest_changes: God's enriching can be mediated through commanded circulation of surplus, grants, and household provision.
The plural marriage command is facilitative rather than coercive because the surah preserves waiting and non-marriage paths.
Marriage becomes a protected household threshold, not an erasure of privacy or sexual boundaries.
The slave-inclusive clause is re-situated among funded release, anti-coercion, and sought fortification.
Enrichment can coexistently include relational sufficiency, not only money.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet linked the focus cluster to repeated surplus and means, explicit onward giving, household food access, anti-exploitation rules, social establishment, and a material joining-to-rain sequence; the split mappings for wideness and the owned-woman term also generated contained counter-readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether suitable primarily means morally righteous, practically compatible, or both.
Whether the marriage branch of enrichment should color this token or remain a lexical outlier beside a financial sense.
How much of divine provision the ayah depicts as socially mediated rather than direct.
Whether the status-exit arc is one integrated program or several adjacent remedies.
The cloud-gap and split-root readings are exploratory analogies and should not be promoted to direct lexical meanings.
